summary: The range of the action of a group-algebra element is invariant under every operator that commutes with the group action; the Hecke operator at w commutes with translations at the chosen places.

steps.claim: By range_groupAlgAction_mem_invtSubmodule it suffices that H_w(X) commutes with formAction g for every g ∈ ∏ GL_r(k_w): formAction g is a scalar ψ(det g) times translation by an element supported at the chosen places, and H_w(X) is linear.

H_w(X) is built from translations supported at w (map_heckePolyOp), and a translation supported at w commutes with one supported at the chosen places, w being none of them nor their conjugates (commute_supportedOn_trivialOn).
steps.lean:
(congrArg _ (map_heckePolyOp (algFormRep _ _ _) X fun _ h ↦ by rw [← Module.End.mul_apply,
  ← (commute_supportedOn_trivialOn h (by grind [liftResidue, mem_trivialOn, mem_supportedOn])).map,
  Module.End.mul_apply]).symm)
